1.consolidated_definition: ‘Dícese de la persona mal vestida.’ Maura. También se refiere a lo que aparece desaliñado. “¡Fíjate qué requerete! Nunca mi casa había ehtáo tan tirá.” René Marqués, La carreta, p. 102.
1.en_consolidated_definition:
Said of a person who is poorly dressed.

Also refers to something that appears disheveled. "Look at what a mess you've made! My house has never been in such a state." René Marqués, The Cart, p. 102.
